_comment: Oracle Fusion SOD (Segregation of Duties) conflict rules. Add, remove, or edit rules to match your organisation's compliance policy. Both role_a and role_b values are matched case-insensitively.

rules.description: Accounts Payable and Accounts Receivable must be held by different users to prevent payment fraud.
Invoice entry and payment processing must be segregated to prevent unauthorised payments.
Supplier master maintenance and invoice entry must be segregated to prevent fictitious vendor fraud.
Supplier master maintenance and payment processing must be segregated.
General ledger journal entry and journal approval/posting must be held by different users.
Journal entry and journal approval must be segregated.
Purchase requesters must not also act as buyers to prevent self-approved purchases.
Buying and procurement approval should be held by different users.
Expense submission and expense approval must not be held by the same user.
Fixed asset additions and asset retirement/disposal should be segregated.
Cash management and accounts payable entry should be held by different users.
Inventory management and purchasing should be segregated to prevent inventory fraud.
HR employee record maintenance and payroll processing must be segregated.
Payroll entry and payroll approval must be held by different users.
